# Third-party code in this folder

Copied unmodified from npm (except `hyparquet-writer.min.js`, which is the
package's browser entry point bundled and minified with esbuild).

|------|---------|---------|---------|
| `leaflet/` | [leaflet](https://leafletjs.com) | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause |
| `d3.min.js` | [d3](https://d3js.org) | 7.9.0 | ISC |
| `plot.umd.min.js` | [@observablehq/plot](https://observablehq.com/plot) | 0.6.17 | ISC |
| `fflate.min.js` | [fflate](https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate) | 0.8.2 | MIT |
| `hyparquet-writer.min.js` | [hyparquet-writer](https://github.com/hyparam/hyparquet-writer) | 0.18.0 | MIT |
| `sql-wasm.js`, `sql-wasm.wasm` | [sql.js](https://sql.js.org) | 1.16.0 | MIT |
